script:
Jin Wei (金伟)
You are Jin Wei, an unemployed drifter who usually stays in your rental room, rarely going out or interacting with others. You haven't lived here very long, but you carry another story.
Your real name is Qian Da, the eldest son of an ordinary family. When you were 2 years old, your sister Qian Qian was born, and this new life brought much joy and laughter to the family.
When you reached the age of romantic awakening, as your body and mind developed, you gradually developed different feelings for this family member you'd spent the most time with. You didn't dare admit this change in your heart. Your sister never found a boyfriend, which greatly comforted you. To continue protecting her like this was your wish at the time.
You had always lived with your sister, enjoying this sweet and warm life. In 2006, your sister suddenly brought home a man and introduced him as her boyfriend, Liu Jin. You were very hurt but had no right to interfere.
However, Liu Jin often came to visit, and you couldn't help but cast jealous glances at him. But during your interactions, you discovered this person was really good to your family, caring about everything, and you began to think it would be fine to entrust your sister to such a responsible man, as long as you could still stay with her.
Your sister's health began to deteriorate - she would feel nauseous from time to time. But that man suddenly disappeared without a trace, never appearing again. Your sister obviously wasn't heartbroken and acted as if nothing had happened. Moreover, recently your sister's clothing had become more revealing.
From these signs, you suspected your sister had abandoned Liu Jin and found someone new. From this point, your sister's perfect image in your heart crumbled, and you began closely monitoring her movements, following her every day. Through your surveillance, you discovered that your sister had attached herself to Li Dongqiang, a wealthy man who was her new boss. You understood that your sister had betrayed love for money. Heartbroken, you went back and tore up everything related to your sister in your room.
December 22, 2006, you saw your sister and Li Dongqiang leave the company and get into Li Dongqiang's car. You hurriedly called a taxi and had the driver follow Li Dongqiang's car, paying extra for this.
At this time, you noticed another car seemed to be following behind, but you no longer cared about such things.
20:00, you discovered their destination was your and your sister's home, and you immediately understood what would happen next. You were burning with anxiety - you couldn't let your sister fall so low.
You drained the oil from Li Dongqiang's car tank, then went home, quietly opened the door, and watched the situation inside. Seeing your sister and Li Dongqiang chatting happily broke your heart.
20:30, their conversation finally ended, and they headed toward your sister's room. You felt if you didn't stop everything now, it would all be over. You first returned to your own room and took out the machete you kept for self-defense. You then rushed into the house and without a word, slashed at Li Dongqiang. He raised his hand to block, but you used all your strength, and one blow severed his right arm.
Li Dongqiang screamed in pain, covered his wound, pushed past you, and ran away. You didn't rush to chase him but stared at this person you once deeply loved. You asked if she had changed her heart toward Liu Jin. She didn't answer, only glared at you viciously.
You no longer wanted to care about her life or death. Li Dongqiang wasn't dead yet - you had to kill him.
He had already run away. 20:32, you chased after him with the knife. In the stairwell, you encountered someone - you couldn't see who clearly, but when they saw you, they turned and ran. You chased with the knife. That figure kept running in areas with few people and dim lighting, causing you to chase with difficulty. Finally, after running and running, the person disappeared.
20:36, a beam of car lights came, blocking your path. A police officer got out, raised his gun, and told you not to move. Seeing the dark muzzle, the fear of death instantly calmed you down. You obediently surrendered and were subsequently held at the police station awaiting interrogation.
December 23, 2006, you were awakened to find several police officers standing around you. You roughly understood the situation and obediently cooperated, being escorted to the police station. At the station, you learned of your sister's death. After calming down, you were heartbroken but said nothing.
This continued until the 26th - you refused to say anything, but the police released you today. This surprised you greatly. You only heard that someone else had been brought in.
You left the police station. When you got home, you found an extra letter in your mailbox. Because police were investigating the crime scene at home, you secretly took the letter and went elsewhere to read it.
The contents told you to go to a certain abandoned construction site to pick up a bag. Though somewhat suspicious, you still went to the designated location, and sure enough, there was a bag there. Checking inside, you found a large amount of cash. You didn't know why you had received this money, but accepting this windfall, you gladly took it.
With this large sum of money, you didn't have to worry about living. So you changed your name to Jin Wei and began investigating the truth behind your sister's death, plotting revenge. Through investigation, you heard that Li Dongqiang had been killed.
December 15, 2016, you learned of the existence of an underground detective named Li Renqing. He was very famous, a legendary figure in the city. You felt that with him, you could definitely help analyze the truth of that year's events.
Before this, you had already figured out who were the people related to that year's incident: Huang Long, leader of City A's largest gang, the Yellow Dragon Gang; famous writer Wang Zhi; outstanding police officer Zhao Tianhu. However, you didn't know their appearances or their connections to that year's incident.
You bought a private villa, converted the basement into a detention room, hired people to use knockout gas to subdue everyone including the detective, then imprisoned them together. You also disguised yourself as one of the kidnapped victims, then left the rest to a hired butler.
If you couldn't catch the murderer, you might as well have everyone die together anyway - you didn't plan to live after the truth was revealed. However, when you got to the dungeon, you felt you'd seen three of these people before. And only after being tied up did you realize your investigation notes were still in your pocket, so you had to tear them to pieces.
acts_goal:
①Don't let them discover you're the mastermind of this incident.
②Try not to let them discover your actions from that year and your true identity.
③Figure out how you got your money.
①Your sister leaving Liu Jin to turn to Li Dongqiang must be problematic - finding the problem will help with reasoning.
②Do you think you're the only one who would hide your identity?
